fixes: Lines 13-14 ('Read cache configured according to' / ' specified parameters.') are set aside as decoration, but they are a status message of LUN 12's read-cache prefetch configuration. The tool can also print 'default parameters' here, so the value varies. Treat a line that matches none of COLON/EQ/SPACED inside a LUN block as the start of a free-text message. Append any following continuation line (one starting with whitespace) to it, and store the joined text 'Read cache configured according to specified parameters.' as one value in the current lun record, under a key such as 'Read cache configuration'. Add lines 13-14 to that block's lines instead of skip. This needs the format-2 parser's ability to join a record across lines.
